Name: Festive Light Bushes
Author: CHA4S3E
Description:
As the feast of the winter star draws near, Someone has been decorating the Bushes in the Town! Starting on Winter 20, You can find bushes that are decorated with Beautiful Lights, Shake them, and you will get Battery Packs! Consider it a Winter Star Gift!

[color=#ff0000][b]More Details
[/b][/color][color=#00ff00]The Festive Bushes will only be found in the Town area of the Map.
[/color]The Festive Bushes are common, so if you don't need any battery packs, it may be good for making money during winter.
[color=#00ff00]Festive Bushes can be found from [u]Winter 20-24
[/u][/color]

Manifest.Description: Puts String Lights on bushes before The Winter Star!
